_comment: The character pipeline's own model file. It is not the recreation pipeline's templates.json, and the recreation scripts never read it. The character scripts (scripts/character/generate.sh and the model command of scripts/character/state.py) read it to refuse an impossible request before it costs anything, and to compute cost. Same shape as known_model_limits in templates.json, plus min_duration_s and max_reference_images. MiniMax H3 Max reference-to-video is the default; MiniMax H3 reference-to-video stays as a second entry. Add another model only with a measured cap and price. max_reference_images is the most pictures one run may attach; every image counts, the start frame too, and the voice clip does not.

output._comment: Generate at 768p, 9:16. Upscale once to 1080x1920 at assembly (lanczos). Never 4K. 9:16 is the only size for now; more sizes are added later when needed.

duration_rules._comment: The recreation rules (state.py model set, generate.sh, AGENTS.md rules 6 and 7), restated for the character copies, with this model's minimum.
duration_rules.whole_seconds: The duration is a whole number of seconds, from min_duration_s (5) to max_duration_s (15). Supagen allows 5 to 15 for both models. A segment planned shorter than 5 s is generated at 5 s and trimmed at assembly.
duration_rules.cap: Check the range when the model is chosen (state.py model set) and again before each generation (generate.sh).
duration_rules.unknown_model: Refuse a model slug that is not in known_model_limits.
duration_rules.duration_field: Set video_settings.duration to null and put the integer in extensions.duration. fal serialises an integer duration as "20s" and rejects its own string.
duration_rules.resolution_field: Put the resolution in extensions as "768P" (uppercase), beside the duration. Every H3 and H3 Max template version so far used this form.
duration_rules.cost: Computed cost = price_per_s x seconds. It is a computed figure, not the billed amount (see supagen_findings.billing).
duration_rules.active_version: The REST invoke endpoint ignores version_number and runs the active version. Change the active version (activate_version over MCP) and the selected model (state.py model set) together, never one without the other.
duration_rules.reference_images: A run attaches at most max_reference_images pictures (4 on the default). generate.sh refuses a refs.json with more. The voice clip is audio and is not counted.

supagen_findings._comment: Read-only checks through the Supagen MCP on 2026-10-02: the model records of both reference models, the versions of earlier templates, the invocation list and traces. No generation.
supagen_findings.price: minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video: price_per_s 0.08, the founder's figure; Supagen's model record lists the same, $0.08 per second. minimax-h3-reference-to-video: price_per_s 0.06, the founder's 768p figure; Supagen's record lists $0.13 per second.
supagen_findings.billing: PARTLY OPEN. minimax-h3-reference-to-video: Supagen records $0.65 for every run (seven runs, 5 to 15 s), the list price x the 5 s minimum. The H3 Max family (text-to-video and image-to-video): Supagen records $0.20 for every run, at 10 s and at 15 s alike, which is less than $0.08 x 5 s. No run of minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video exists yet. What the provider charges cannot be read from Supagen: compare the provider account after the first paid run. Until then, plan each H3 Max run at the computed figure, $0.08 x seconds, which is the higher of the two.
supagen_findings.template_settings: SETTLED. The earlier H3 Max templates (text-to-video, 16:9, six versions) used video_settings {aspect_ratio, n 1, generate_audio true, extensions {duration: 5 to 15, resolution: "768P"}}. The ugc-character template and its v1 version are defined in templates.json beside this file; the setup skill creates them in each workspace.
supagen_findings.resolution: SETTLED. minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video allows 480p, 768p, 1080p (768p native; 1080p is the provider's refinement, price at 1080p not listed). minimax-h3-reference-to-video allows 480p, 768p, 2K, 4K. Send "768P"; upscale once to 1080p at assembly.
supagen_findings.audio: OPEN. The H3 Max reference record says supports_audio_generation true and its description keeps the self-composed soundtrack, but its capabilities list audio_output false. The H3 Max text-to-video runs had audio on. Check the first paid run for a sound track before any talking segment counts on it.
supagen_findings.references: minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video takes at most 4 reference images (minimax-h3-reference-to-video takes 9), and also video and audio references. It has no video extension.
supagen_findings.output_length: SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT for minimax-h3-reference-to-video: outputs run 0.1 to 0.6 s long (5 s gave 5.184 s, 6 s gave 6.592 s, 15 s gave 15.104 s). Not measured yet for H3 Max reference. Trim to the planned length at assembly.

face_replace._comment: Founder, 2026-10-04: an X segment (a reaction hook) may run in face-replace mode: the trimmed, masked reference clip and the character's approved face go to a video-to-video model that keeps the motion and timing and replaces the face. generate.sh runs that mode only on a known_model_limits entry whose "modes" lists "face_replace". No entry has it today, so generate.sh refuses a face-replace run before any cost.
face_replace.status: NO MODEL. Neither minimax-h3-max-reference-to-video nor minimax-h3-reference-to-video replaces a face: they accept video references as conditioning of a new generation, which does not keep the clip's frames, motion and timing (and is not tested). No model of scripts/templates.json is video-to-video.
face_replace.proposal: Wan 2.2 Animate in replace mode (on fal as wan/v2.2-14b/animate/replace): a video plus one character image; it keeps the motion, expression and timing of the video and replaces the person with the character, relit to the scene. Not checked in Supagen: before it is added, read its Supagen model record (read-only, no run) for the slug, the price per second, the length and resolution limits, and the input fields; then add it here with "modes": ["face_replace"], add a template version in templates.json, and write the video-input part of the request in generate.sh (today it sends pictures and one audio clip only). Its first paid run is the founder's decision.
face_replace.fallback: generation_input none: the written expression beats, generated by the default model from the keyframe and the character's references.
